slides.headline: A $500-AN-HOUR VC, A $3,000 GROWTH AGENCY, AND A CFO ARE ALL SITTING INSIDE CLAUDE FOR FREE, HERE IS HOW TO USE THEM
hook_candidates: CLAUDE HAS 5 FREE ADVISORS MOST OWNERS NEVER FIND
5 FREE BOARD ADVISORS YOU NEVER KNEW CLAUDE HAD
CLAUDE IS HIDING 5 FREE EXPERTS FROM EVERY BUSINESS OWNER
5 EXPERT ADVISORS FREE INSIDE CLAUDE RIGHT NOW

slides.headline: 1) GET A VC TO TEAR YOUR PITCH APART
slides.body: A pitch deck coach charges $500 an hour. Prompt: 'Act as a senior VC. Here is my pitch: [paste]. List every investor objection and tell me exactly how to fix each one.'

slides.headline: 2) FIND YOUR BIGGEST UNTAPPED CHANNEL
slides.body: Growth agencies charge $3,000 a month for this exact audit. Prompt: 'Act as a growth marketer. My business: [describe]. Name the single biggest acquisition channel I am ignoring and give three steps to test it for under $500.'

slides.headline: 3) LET A CFO AUDIT YOUR COSTS RIGHT NOW
slides.body: A fractional CFO charges $200 an hour to find where your business bleeds money. Prompt: 'Act as a CFO. Expenses: [paste]. Find the three most oversized costs and tell me what to do about each.'

slides.headline: 4) FIND OUT WHY PEOPLE DON'T BUY FROM YOU
slides.body: Consumer research firms charge $5,000 for a report that answers this one question. Prompt: 'Act as a consumer psychologist. Product: [describe], page: [paste]. List the five real reasons people do not buy, plus one sales page fix for each.'

slides.headline: 5) FIND THE PROCESS WASTING YOUR MOST HOURS
slides.body: Operations consultants charge $400 an hour to find this. Prompt: 'Act as an operations consultant. My week: [describe]. Find the single process stealing the most hours and give three steps to cut it in half.'

slides.headline: SAVE THIS
slides.body:
You will want these when you need them. Each prompt is ready the moment a tough investor question, a slow sales week, or a cost problem shows up.

Daily AI news and real skills

caption:
Swipe through. Five prompts that each replace an expert you would normally pay hundreds of dollars an hour for. 🧠

One, the VC prompt that finds every hole in your pitch before investors do. Two, the growth marketer prompt that spots the customer channel you have been ignoring. Three, the CFO prompt that finds the exact costs bleeding your business right now. Four, the customer psychologist prompt that tells you the real reason people visit your page and still do not buy. Five, the ops expert prompt that finds the process wasting the most hours in your business every single week.

Most business owners skip expert advice because it costs too much, not because it is hard to find. These prompts close that gap. They work because locking Claude into one expert role with one specific job changes what it produces. Running a business? DM us 'AI' and we will show you what this looks like for yours.
